Deploy-now = rungs placed now: resting limits only where trend allows (SPCX up, COP mixed); weak-trend names confirm with a daily close above the prior day's high in the zone; 0% when R<1.5 at the zone or a trend knockout. allocation.method: Score 0-10 per name: setup = half R from the data-based entry to T1 (x2.5) + half Trading Assistant long-term score; risk = 10 minus penalties for ATR% and ATM IV (and short history); upside = % to top structure, blended 50/50 with the published PT median when one exists; macro/news (judgment from the 7-day news and copper note); concentration (diversification value). Composite = 30/25/20/15/10. Split proportional to composite^2 / sqrt(ATR%) (volatile = smaller, about equal dollar risk; TEM x1.1 for its quoted put) x study-agreement multiplier (1 + 0.15 x agreement score, new in planRev 163), scaled to 85% invested, then caps: 25% per name, tech/semis 40%, space 25%, energy/materials 30% (excess to cash); 10% reserve + 5% held back. Rounded to 0.25%. Deploy-now = rungs placed now: resting limits only where trend allows (SPCX up, COP mixed); weak-trend names confirm with a daily close above the prior day's high in the zone; 0% when R<1.5 at the zone or a trend knockout. Rung sizes weighted by estimated odds, min ~10 shares.
